Hello all,

First I would like to say thank you to anyone who has supported and encouraged me through the development of Bleat. Your support kept me going for a long time.

I disappeared from Voat for quite a while. After some events occurred in my life, I did a little bit of a reevaluation of my priorities. As a student trying to get into one of the most competitive computer science programs in the country, I felt the responsibility hit me pretty hard come test season. The good news is that I did very well in the fall. The other news is that my time away from Voat has shifted my view of it greatly.

I very much enjoy coming here. The front page is usually amusing and informative. It's great. Though I acknowledged something that bothered me from the start. Voat's uneasy and inflammatory community at large. Rooted in almost everything is a condescending tone or a straight insult to others. The humor that makes it to the front page is usually at someone else's expense. There are also so many trolls that complain about Jews or blacks, or crazy partisans that think the damn liberals are ruining the country when they too are also just as guilty, which I cannot stand. In general, too much negativity for me to handle. Even being around that kind of thinking puts me on edge, because it's easy to fall into when it's "funny".

I realized that even minutes a day reading some article about so-and-so doing whatever illegal thing was enough to distract me for a while after reading (because it makes you WTF so much).

Originally I intended for Bleat to stay on the Google play Store. Yet because of a mistake on my part (forgot to upload in beta mode), and because of the torrential influx of negative reviews, I decided to hide the listing. The feedback was great but the reviews actually would affect the future success of the app, and possibly myself. Bleat was first and foremost a learning experience in my exploration of mobile development, and I wasn't going to let a beta app and a number of impatient individuals drag down my rating.

So with that, I can say that I don't really know when Bleat will be back in development. I have school to focus on, and my life has only gotten busier. I certainly enjoyed developing it for Voat, though. So perhaps I will revisit the app in the future.

With that I say farewell for now, and good luck in all your endeavors.
